public fun liquidate_adl_borrow<MarketType, DebtType, CollateralType>(
    app: &ProtocolApp,
    cap: &PackageCallerCap,

    obligation_id: ID,
    market: &mut Market<MarketType>,

    available_repay_coin: Coin<DebtType>,

    coin_decimals_registry: &CoinDecimalsRegistry,
    x_oracle: &XOracle,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
) {
    pre_liquidation_check<MarketType>(app, cap, market, protocol::whitelist_admin::adl());

    let now = clock::timestamp_ms(clock) / 1000;
    let repay_amount = available_repay_coin.value();

    let (collateral_balance, refund, ctoken_amount) = market.handle_debt_auto_deleverage<MarketType, DebtType, CollateralType>(
        obligation_id,
        available_repay_coin,
        coin_decimals_registry,
        x_oracle,
        clock,
        now,
        ctx,
    );

    post_liquidation<MarketType, DebtType, CollateralType>(
        now, 
        repay_amount,
        refund.value(),
        LiquidationType::ADLBorrow, 
        obligation_id, 
        market, 
        collateral_balance.value(),
        ctoken_amount, 
        x_oracle, 
        clock,
